actions.action: Classify scene reachability with inspectable evidence
actions.mechanism: Explore scene-and-state configurations; distinguish witnessed reachability, proven unreachability, and exploration stopped at a declared limit.
actions.implementation: Declare initial states and exploration limits. Store predecessor choices and updates; attach exhausted-frontier certificates to unreachable scenes. Treat unsupported code as unknown.
actions.check: Replay reachable witnesses. Verify unreachable certificates against every modeled transition; lowering limits must produce unknown, not unreachable.

actions.action: Analyze loops using state, not scene repetition
actions.mechanism: Detect closed configuration sets without exits; revisiting a scene alone does not establish a trap.
actions.implementation: Find reachable cycles and test feasible exits. Show an entry trace, relevant variable changes, and blocked exit conditions; leave incomplete analyses unresolved.
actions.check: Test a counter-incrementing loop exiting after three visits and another with an impossible exit; only the latter should be proven trapped.
actions.risk: Unbounded state can prevent a conclusive result.

actions.mechanism: Attach intentions to specific findings and relevant state conditions rather than silencing entire scenes or loops.
actions.implementation: Add intentional-loop and hidden-scene annotations containing finding identifiers, rationale, state scope, and dependency fingerprints. Keep findings visible; flag exceptions for review after dependency changes.
actions.check: Mark one loop intentional, then introduce a separate trap in the same scene; the new warning must remain unsuppressed.
actions.risk: Overly broad exception scopes can conceal new defects.

actions.action: Compare playtest traces against modeled transitions
actions.mechanism: Observed choices and state changes can expose modeling mismatches without treating missing observations as proof of unreachability.
actions.implementation: Instrument playtests to record scene, choice, and pre/post state. Replay traces against the analyzed revision; display the first divergence and invalidate affected conclusions.
actions.check: Inject an unexpected state update and verify a replayable mismatch appears. Unvisited scenes must remain unobserved, not become proven unreachable.
actions.risk: Playtests sample behavior; stale or nondeterministic traces require explicit labeling.
